```{r setup}
# This document requires two prepared environments and fails loudly if either is
# missing:
#   - Python: `uv sync` (creates ../.venv)
#   - R:      `renv::restore()` inside docs/ (installs the pinned packages)
# Params files live in docs/: fast_params.yml for quick renders and
# prd_params.yml for the full run, e.g.:
#   quarto render docs --execute-params docs/fast_params.yml
#   quarto render docs --execute-params docs/prd_params.yml
# Override single values with -P, e.g. -P n_sim_confounded:1000000
docs_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))

# Force all libraries to be loaded from the renv environment.
options(renv.config.synchronized.check = FALSE)
renv::load(project = docs_dir, quiet = TRUE)

# Point reticulate at the Python environment one level above docs/.
library(reticulate)
venv <- file.path(docs_dir, "..", ".venv")
use_virtualenv(normalizePath(venv), required = TRUE)
```
